summary: Plugin-owned model continuations through the native composer send path: a plugin can register a continuation intent so switching model keeps one conversation. Without it the Console falls back to bb's own Handoff to a new thread. General enough for get-bb/bb.

probe.detail: The browser-side composer handle has experimental_setContinuationIntent (typeof === 'function'). Provided by packages/plugin-sdk/src/app-contract.ts and packages/plugin-sdk/src/internal/composer-handle.ts in the fork. The Console already probes it at src/native-continuation.ts:23 and falls back to the Handoff prompt when it is absent.

summary: Import a Claude or Codex session from the machine as a thread (bb native-history, host-daemon commands, SDK area), start a task in the background and keep composing, device-local draft storage and iPhone dictation for the mobile app, and an agent-context contribution hook. One large fork commit carries all of these.

probe.detail: The browser SDK has experimental_nativeHistory (read at src/context-workspace-native-history.tsx:58); the composer handle has experimental_submitInBackground (src/context-workspace.tsx:1164) and experimental_deviceDraftStorage (src/context-workspace-offline.ts:159). All are added by 3fc102507 (packages/sdk/src/areas/native-history.ts, packages/plugin-sdk/src/app-contract.ts). S01 and S02 are the iOS app only (apps/mobile/modules/bb-dictation, apps/mobile/src/lib/drafts) and need a signed fork build of the app: no plugin probe, hide unless the native-history probe passes and the app build is ours.

summary: Protected removal of managed worktrees (keeps references, local files and busy trees) and native delivery helpers. Shares commit 43d0bcd81 with ios-live-activities. Needs a reviewed core patch; general enough to upstream.

probe.detail: The environment-git-worktree plugin answers experimental_cleanupSafety with version 1 (plugins/environment-git-worktree/server.ts:53, host/protected-removal.ts). The Console already calls it at server-delivery.ts:441 and refuses cleanup when it fails.

summary: iOS live activities and notification controls for the mobile app (apps/mobile/modules/bb-live-activities, Settings, Mobile). Shares commit 43d0bcd81 with protected-worktree-removal. Needs a signed fork build of the iOS app.

probe.detail: no probe; hide unless release build detected by the release-build marker (server SDK: typeof bb.sdk.system.experimental_acquireUpdateDrain === 'function'; browser: typeof composer.experimental_setContinuationIntent === 'function'). The plugin does not draw this feature and cannot see which iOS app build the user holds, so this only says the server is the fork; the feature stays blocked until a signed app build is proven.

summary: Bind an automation run to the host that actually resolves, and refuse admission when the execution configuration changed since it was reviewed (fingerprint and expected host). Webhook-started agent tasks depend on it so a hook cannot start on the wrong machine.

probe.detail: automations_create and automations_update responses carry experimental_hostGuard: true, and the automations plugin answers experimental_automations_execution_guard (plugins/automations/src/rpc.ts:22, rpc-types.ts). The Console already refuses to save a hook without the flag (server-webhook-admin.ts, HOST_GUARD_MISSING) and calls the guard at server-attention-integrations.ts:371.

summary: Durable update drain and admission for native work paths, an exact identified app update apply for fleet owners, a provider install guarded to the reviewed version, and an update-drain count that cannot block the server. Fleet uses it to apply updates only when no work is running. Without it the Update buttons stay unavailable and nothing is launched.

probe.detail: The server SDK has bb.sdk.system.experimental_acquireUpdateDrain (also experimental_updateDrainStatus, experimental_armUpdateDrain, experimental_cancelUpdateDrain, experimental_releaseUpdateDrain), added in packages/sdk/src/areas/system.ts by b2c26aaf8. The Fleet plugin already checks it in fleet/owner/core-drain-adapter.ts:25-44 and reports the update as unavailable when it is missing.

summary: An opaque subscription id on provider usage limits, only for token-bound identities, so two machines on the same subscription can be counted once. Without it the Console asks you to confirm the link by hand.

probe.detail: Each entry of the usage-limits answer carries experimental_subscriptionId (string or null): packages/server-contract/src/api/system.ts and apps/server/src/services/system/usage-limits.ts. Fleet reads it at fleet/owner/operations.ts:692.

summary: The model picker shows that the catalogue is loading before declaring a provider empty.

summary: Composer rich-text extension points: effect ranges that hide their markers while the caret is outside, table grids drawn in place of Markdown tables, a paste transform, and paste-without-formatting that skips plugin transforms. Without it the navmotion-skin Markdown preview still paints bold, italics and headings but the markers stay visible and tables stay as text.

probe.detail: no probe; hide unless release build detected by the release-build marker (server SDK: typeof bb.sdk.system.experimental_acquireUpdateDrain === 'function'; browser: typeof composer.experimental_setContinuationIntent === 'function'; both fork-only, and the fork keeps the upstream version string 0.48.1). The new fields are hiddenClassName, tableClassName, effect ranges with hidden or table, and transformPaste (packages/plugin-sdk/src/app-contract.ts, internal/composer-customization-validation.ts). The fork's validator copies only the fields it knows, so an older core is expected to ignore them; that was read in the code, not run on stock bb. Nothing in the SDK reports that the core understood them.

summary: Detect an icon in the project, choose a file, or generate a monogram and colour; stored with the project and sent to the sidebar. Without it the rail still shows emoji, symbol and colour choices but never a detected image or generated monogram.

probe.detail: Each project handed to the sidebar thread list has experimental_icon ({ imageUrl, monogram, hue }), declared in packages/plugin-sdk/src/app-contract.ts and filled by toPluginSidebarProjectIcon in apps/app/src/lib/plugin-sidebar-hooks.ts. The Console reads it at src/rail-icons.tsx:21 and treats undefined as an older host. Probe by checking that at least one project object carries the key.

The change is inside the bundled github-pr-status plugin (plugins/github-pr-status/host/gitlab-host.ts) whose package version was not bumped, so its version string does not show it.
